summary: The candidate source removes draft_probs from the target-only ABI and implements scratch-free rejected-token masking, but its changed CUDA/FlashInfer native operator could not be rebuilt or executed on the prepared ROCm-only MI350X. Source and algebra checks are supportive, not sufficient to verify the complete functional and efficiency contract.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction of the old API: the prepared native wrapper requires draft_probs. Log: /job/review-evidence-j-1be7aebf4c51/base-candidate-regression.log

All three candidate tests failed before dispatch because source imported the unchanged prepared sgl_kernel wheel with the old ABI; this is import-path evidence, not a candidate functional failure. Log: /job/review-evidence-j-1be7aebf4c51/candidate-tests-installed-native.log

Real candidate native build attempt failed at CMake configuration because nvcc/CUDA toolkit is absent. The assigned ROCm build excludes the changed speculative_sampling.cu operator. Log: /job/review-evidence-j-1be7aebf4c51/candidate-native-build.log

Confirmed source ABI removal and algebraic equivalence of old dense scratch subtraction to rejected-ID masking, including randomized duplicate IDs. This did not compile or execute native code. Log: /job/review-evidence-j-1be7aebf4c51/independent-static-checks.log

gpu_execution_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) was visible with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, but no candidate kernel executed. GPU tensor allocation before the old-wrapper TypeError is not counted as candidate GPU execution.
remaining_counterexamples: Candidate-native forced rejection followed by independent masked-CDF sampling was not executable.
Multiple rejected siblings and duplicate candidate token IDs were not tested on device.
All-drafts-accepted bonus sampling, boundary uniform samples, and multi-batch behavior were not independently tested on device.
No timing or resource benchmark verifies the requested top-k=1 efficiency improvement.
remaining_limitations: The assigned architecture is AMD MI350X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2; the changed operator is in the CUDA/FlashInfer build and is excluded from setup_rocm.py.
No CUDA toolkit/nvcc, NVIDIA GPU, MUSA toolchain, or MUSA device was available.
The prepared sgl_kernel wheel retained the old ABI, so source/native paths could not be combined into a valid candidate runtime.
Static source and CPU algebra checks cannot prove native compilation, GPU numerical behavior, or performance.
